questions.q: In mail merge, the placeholder <<City>> inserted in the main document is called a —
questions.solution: **Merge fields** (shown inside double angle brackets) mark where each data-source value will be filled in.

questions.q: A file is selected in File Explorer. Pressing Alt+Enter will:
questions.solution: Alt+Enter opens the Properties dialog (size, location, dates, attributes). Enter opens the file, F2 renames it and Delete sends it to the Recycle Bin.

questions.q: Phishing carried out over a PHONE CALL is called —
questions.solution: **Vishing** = Voice phishing; SMS-based phishing is smishing.

questions.q: A caller says he is from your bank and asks for the OTP you just received. You should —
options: Refuse — banks never ask for OTPs
Share it if he knows your name
questions.solution: **No genuine bank ever asks for OTP/PIN/CVV** — an OTP shared is money gone.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: Occurrence: double c, double r, **-ence** ending. Occurance/Ocurrance take -ance; Occurence drops an r.

questions.q:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, "Alas! I am ruined."
options: He said with sorrow that he is ruined.
He exclaimed with sorrow that he is ruined.
He exclaimed with sorrow that he was ruined.
He exclaimed with joy that he was ruined.
questions.solution: Alas → **exclaimed with sorrow**; am → was (backshift); I → he. B inverts the tone; C leaves the tense; D strands 'is'.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution: Rhythm has **no vowel except y**: Rh-y-th-m. Mnemonic: Rhythm Helps Your Two Hips Move. Rhythem plants a fake e; Rythm drops the h.

questions.q: Parts of a sentence are given as options in order. One part contains an error; the other three are correct. Select the part with the error.
questions.solution: The true subject is **the number** (singular); *applicants* sits inside the 'of' phrase and cannot decide the verb. Part 2 must read **has doubled**. The other parts are grammatical.
questions.shortcut: Cover the 'of' phrase; the number is singular.

questions.q: Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.solution: The **liver** is the largest gland (and largest internal organ). It secretes bile, stores glycogen and detoxifies substances. The pituitary is the 'master gland', not the largest.

questions.q: **Ornithology** is the study of —
questions.solution: **Ornithology = birds** (Salim Ali, the birdman of India, was its greatest name here). Entomology is insects.

questions.q: To which deity are the **largest number of Rigvedic hymns** addressed?
questions.solution: **Indra** (~250 hymns; called *Purandara*, breaker of forts) leads, followed by **Agni** (~200). Varuna guards cosmic order (rita); Soma has Mandala IX.
questions.shortcut: Indra first, Agni second — keep the order.

questions.q: The **GST Council** was established under —
questions.solution: **Article 279A** (101st Amendment, 2016) creates the GST Council; 246A grants the taxing power and 269A handles IGST apportionment. 280 is the Finance Commission.

questions.q: The average of 5 numbers is 27. If one more number 37 is included, the new average is:
questions.solution:
Old sum $= 135$. New sum $= 135 + 37 = 172$.
New average $= \frac{172}{6} = 28.5$.
questions.shortcut: 37 is 10 above the old average; the extra 10 spreads over 6 numbers: 27 + 10/6 = 28.5.

questions.q: Two solutions of 20% and 50% acid are mixed to obtain a 30% acid solution. The ratio in which they should be mixed is:
The price of a car is 50% more than that of a bike. The price of the bike is what per cent less than that of the car?
A wheel of diameter 70 cm makes 300 revolutions. The distance travelled by the wheel is: [Use $\pi=\frac{22}{7}$]
questions.solution:
Circumference $=\frac{22}{7}\times0.7=2.2$ m.

Distance $=300\times2.2=660$ m.
questions.shortcut: $d=0.7$ m → 2.2 m per revolution → 660 m. Trap: 6,600 m (cm-m slip).

questions.q: How many triangles are there in the given figure?
questions.solution: The rectangle with both diagonals gives 8 triangles (4 small + 4 half-rectangles). The roof is 1 more. The roof cannot combine with any lower piece, since its sides do not continue down. Total **9**.

questions.q: The figure shows the **mirror image** of a wall clock (the dot marks 12). What is the actual time?
questions.solution: The dot marks 12. Read the picture as it is: the hands show **7:50**. That is the mirror image, so the actual time = 11:60 − 7:50 = **4:10**. Check: 7:50 + 4:10 = 12:00.
questions.shortcut: Read the picture, then subtract from 11:60.

questions.solution: A real view can never show two opposite faces together. Three options show a pair from (M–R, N–O, O–N), so they are impossible. The remaining view shows one face from each opposite pair, and such a view can always be turned up on the die.
questions.shortcut: Reject every view that shows an opposite pair.

questions.q: What is the position of the letter **W from the right** of the English alphabet?
questions.solution: W = 23 from the left → 27 − 23 = **4th** from the right (Z 1st, Y 2nd, X 3rd, W 4th).
